reuse.why: Replaces three copied category queries with one getMonthActionCategories and one isSkippedByMonthAction predicate used by all month-wide actions; the income/tracking check is still repeated inline at each site rather than folded in.

duplication.why: Removes the triplicated SQL, but the goal_def IS NOT NULL AS has_templates expression is written in both getBudgetData and getMonthActionCategories, and the is_income/tracking guard stays in four places.

placement.why: Selection query and predicate live in budget/actions.ts next to the actions that use them.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, focused tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: The hidden/group-hidden/template rule is one named predicate fed by one query; a maintainer still has to keep the per-site income guard and the two has_templates SQL expressions aligned.

one_place.where: isSkippedByMonthAction in server/budget/actions.ts decides the hidden/group-hidden/template skip for copyPreviousMonth, setZero and set3/6/12MonthAvg; the has_templates flag it reads is computed by the same SQL expression in getBudgetData and getMonthActionCategories.
